title: Leak: pilots fly ET craft through psionic assets with a brain-machine interface

tellings.quote: So, they devised a way to connect a psionic person to [music] an advanced brain machine interface where the pilot can control the machine to control the person's intentions, and in turn control the ET craft.

plain: Jesse Michels, a podcast host, passes on a 2023 leak from an anonymous source going by the name "Joey is not my name," and mentions a witness named Michael Herrera. According to the leak, people with claimed mind powers, called psionic people, are hooked up to an advanced brain-machine interface, a device linking a brain to a machine, so that a pilot can guide that person's intentions and through them fly an alien craft. If true, it would mean these craft can only be flown by the mind.
